title: JPMorgan targets Canton Network for next phase of JPM Coin
summary: JPMorgan’s Kinexys unit is taking JPM Coin beyond its existing rails, planning a native launch of the US dollar deposit token on the Canton Network.

title: Nike offloads RTFKT months after investor lawsuit: Report
summary: The reported divestment follows Nike’s closure of its digital collectibles unit and comes as market pressures continue to weigh on NFTs.

title: Blockchain innovation must rise above politics and serve real-world needs
summary: Innovation thrives only when blockchain and crypto remain apolitical, compliant and interoperable, ensuring technology serves trust, not political agendas.

title: Morgan Stanley adds Ethereum staking ETF filing to growing crypto lineup
summary: The investment banking giant is seeking to capture additional yield from the proposed ETF’s Ether holdings via staking, as institutional investors launch more regulated crypto funds.

title: Stablecoins become core market plumbing in Moody’s 2026 outlook
summary: Moody’s said stablecoins and tokenized deposits are evolving into institutional “digital cash,” with trillions in onchain settlement volume and billions in infrastructure investment.

title: Barclays makes first stablecoin investment with stake in Ubyx
summary: Barclays has invested in Ubyx, a US stablecoin clearing platform, marking a major move into regulated digital money and tokenized financial services.

title: Ethereum and Solana clash over what blockchain resilience really means
summary: Vitalik and Solana's Yakovenko outline competing ideas about resilience, exposing deeper trade-offs between sovereignty, speed and economic design.

title: UAE’s dirham stablecoin race widens as RAKBank nets in-principle approval
summary: RAKBank's in-principle nod from the Central Bank of the UAE to launch a dirham-backed stablecoin adds a homegrown bank to the UAE’s stablecoin race.

title: Trump says he’ll be impeached if Republicans lose midterms
summary: US President Donald Trump says he will be impeached by the Democrats if the Republicans fail to win the midterms, which could galvanize resistance to his crypto policy agenda.

title: Wealth transfer may boost crypto adoption among younger investors: Galaxy exec
summary: An industry executive argues that generational wealth transfer could influence crypto adoption patterns over time.
